operation.description: Live authorization precedes every aggregate and page. Platform Admins/Auditors read totals; personal keys are never selectable by a platform key filter. Shared members see only their own human-key activity; workspace administrators see workspace-wide activity, and foreign personal details are hidden. Costs are configured-rate estimates, not invoices; known subtotals and retained held floors are not proven upper bounds. Unknown values remain null. Cost-center dimensions use admission snapshots, not current assignments. Platform Admins and Auditors also see personal workspaces by identity (id and "Personal · <owner>" name) with their usage and cost totals and platform-managed configuration; never their keys, request or execution details, prompts or owner choices.
